title: Compactly supported continuous unit-norm extension of a covector field from a compact set
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, Λ := Covector (Euclid P) n and |·| := covectorEuclideanNorm. Let K ⊆ V ⊆ ℝ^P with K compact and V open. Let β : ℝ^P → Λ be continuous on K with |β(x)| ≤ 1 for all x ∈ K. Then there is a continuous g : ℝ^P → Λ with compact support such that tsupport g ⊆ V, |g(x)| ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^P, and g(x) = β(x) for every x ∈ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (K V : Set (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → IsOpen V → K ⊆ V → ContinuousOn β K → (∀ x ∈ K, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, g x = β x
